title_original: Brain Processing Unit — The Future Where Biology and Computer Integrate
title_translation: 脑处理单元——生物与计算机融合的未来
materials_technology: cerebral organoids | iPS-cell-derived neural tissue | multi-electrode arrays | electrical stimulation | connectoids | APIs | robot control
mechanism: 培养神经回路接受电刺激并通过电极阵列测量活动，接口把复杂实验流程模块化；作品把脑类器官的反应连接到音乐识别、机器人控制与生命节律研究。
themes: brain organoid | biological computing | art and science | rhythm | alternative intelligence

materials_technology: mathematical polyrhythms | DSP synthesis | real-time graphics | laser | interactive control
mechanism: 复节奏和相位关系同时组织声音合成、视觉参数与激光控制；表演不是给音乐添加可视化，而是让多种媒介共享一个可演奏的时间系统。
themes: polyrhythm | audiovisual performance | phase | synthesis | live coding

medium: solo exhibition | spatial audiovisual installation | generative sound installation
materials_technology: PolyNodes | 3D architectural scan | audience-position sensing | multi-channel sound | real-time visualization | projection | augmented reality
dimensions: four installations across VS. STUDIO A/B/C and V Space
venues: VS., Grand Green Osaka, 6 Sep–14 Oct 2024
mechanism: 建筑扫描和观众位置进入 PolyNodes 的宏观/中观/微观参数，驱动声音位置、强度和音色变化；同一数据同步生成投影、阴影和 AR 结构。
themes: spatial sound | architecture | generative synthesis | audience data | Xenakis

materials_technology: green-screen video | real-time generative AI | audience text input | image effects | interactive interface
venues: NTT InterCommunication Center [ICC], Tokyo, 16 Dec 2023–10 Mar 2024
mechanism: 界面接收观众提示词，生成模型把预先拍摄的人物前景与动态背景效果合成；持续输入让音乐影像从固定成片变成可共同改写的展览系统。
themes: real-time AI | audience prompt | music video | archive | participation

materials_technology: webcam | SDXL Turbo | real-time image-to-image diffusion | Stable Audio | large LED display | text-to-music
venues: W Osaka, 15–25 Dec 2023 | KIKK Festival, Namur, 2024 | FILE São Paulo, 2025 | The Tech Interactive, San Jose, 2026
mechanism: 摄像头持续捕捉观众，SDXL Turbo 以约实时速度执行 image-to-image；提示、身体姿态、生成图像与 Stable Audio 声音形成循环，时间一致性与低延迟成为关键工程问题。
themes: AI mirror | real-time diffusion | public interaction | body image | temporal consistency

medium: immersive dance performance | virtual reality | mobility experience
materials_technology: VR headsets | program-controlled mobility vehicles | LED | motion capture | network synchronization
mechanism: 载具路径、头显影像、现场舞者与空间灯光同步；观众的身体被系统实际搬运，使视觉运动与前庭、本体感觉之间的偏差成为作品核心。
themes: virtual reality | embodiment | mobility | choreography | fiction and reality

medium: generative-AI installation | public artwork | text and image installation
materials_technology: Node.js | Puppeteer | Yahoo! News comments | rinna japanese-gpt2-medium | Hugging Face Transformers | SentencePiece | VQGAN+CLIP | LED display | mosaic lens
venues: Pavilion Tokyo 2021, WATARI-UM open space, Tokyo, 1 Jul–5 Sep 2021
mechanism: 抓取 577 篇新闻及评论，筛选语料微调 rinna GPT-2；官方口号被翻译为图像提示交给 VQGAN+CLIP。LED 与马赛克透镜控制文字的可读距离，使接近行为成为观看过滤器。
themes: public discourse | generative AI | data scraping | Olympics | pandemic | algorithmic bias

medium: music video | diminished reality | machine-learning image production
materials_technology: object detection | semantic segmentation | depth estimation | image inpainting | manual annotation | Max | C++ | Spleeter
mechanism: 机器学习负责物体、人物和深度估计，人工补充周期变化的广告位置；各数据层生成遮罩并进入修补与故障合成管线，声音分轨控制视觉事件。
themes: diminished reality | urban interface | machine learning | advertising | image manipulation

materials_technology: machine learning | motion capture | projection | real-time graphics | drone
mechanism: 动捕数据训练或驱动生成系统，真实舞者、投影中的合成运动和舞台装置在实时坐标中对齐；模型输出既是影像，也是新的编舞材料。
themes: machine learning | dance | synthetic body | motion data | co-creation

materials_technology: fMRI | brain decoding | machine learning | image reconstruction | data visualization
mechanism: 实验数据训练或驱动图像重建模型；听觉刺激引发的脑活动被映射为逐步变化的图像，使模型误差和神经表征差异成为视觉语言。
themes: brain decoding | cross-modal imagination | machine learning | neuroscience | reconstruction

materials_technology: LED | lens array | robot arm | light-field reconstruction | computational light
dimensions: duration 1 minute; installation dimensions not stated
mechanism: LED 与透镜阵列重建具有方向信息的光线，机器人臂改变光学单元位置；计算生成的光场和实际空间中的光被同步编排。
themes: computational light | real and virtual | optics | robotics | perception

materials_technology: fMRI | brain decoding | pose reconstruction | motion manipulation | avatar
mechanism: 脑活动被解码为姿态数据，姿态再转为数字化身与编舞序列；系统主动改变物理约束，使“被想象的身体”与现实身体分离。
themes: brain decoding | choreography | avatar | body without body | neuroscience

medium: 360-degree VR live stream | music performance | audiovisual production
materials_technology: 360-degree video | virtual reality | real-time graphics | motion tracking | lighting control
mechanism: 现场摄影、表演者追踪、图形生成和灯光控制在同一时间基准上运行，观众通过可自由转向的球形影像进入被扩展的舞台。
themes: live media | immersive video | music visualization | real-time systems | remote presence

materials_technology: 24 compact drones | motion capture | drone control | moving lights | real-time programming
mechanism: 动捕与飞行控制协调舞者、无人机和灯光的时空关系；预编路径和现场反馈共同约束机器群，使人类身体与自动化物体形成编舞。
themes: choreography | robotics | collective motion | risk | human-machine performance

materials_technology: electromagnetic-wave sensing | LED display | real-time sonification | spectrum analysis
venues: Sapporo International Art Festival, 2014 | ICC, Tokyo, 2023
mechanism: 传感设备扫描不同频段，软件把频率分布、信号强弱与时间变化映射到多声道声音和 LED 视觉，使通信基础设施成为可感知的环境。
themes: electromagnetic spectrum | infrastructure | sonification | visualization | ecology

title_translation: 击剑追踪与可视化系统
medium: sports visualization | augmented-reality broadcast | research system
materials_technology: reflective markers | optical motion capture | high-speed cameras | YOLO v3 | 24 × 4K cameras | 3D reconstruction | pose estimation
venues: H.I.H. Prince Takamado Trophy Fencing World Cup, Tokyo, 2019
mechanism: 系统先用反光标记和动捕定位剑尖，后转向无标记图像识别；2019 年版本整合 24 台 4K 摄像机、YOLO v3 检测与多视角三维估计。
themes: sports data | computer vision | augmented reality | tracking | readability

medium: web project | performance data archive | open data
materials_technology: motion-capture data | WebGL | open-source data | network participation
mechanism: 官方数据不只作为演出后台资产，而被发布为开放的动作与声音素材；全球用户可以在浏览器和自有工具中重组同一套身体数据。
themes: open data | networked performance | motion capture | participation | fan creativity

materials_technology: wireless light-emitting balls | rail system | laser tracking | motion capture | custom control software
venues: Yamaguchi Center for Arts and Media [YCAM], 2011 | Rhizomatiks_Multiplex, Museum of Contemporary Art Tokyo, 2021
mechanism: 升降与轨道机构维持球体循环，追踪系统获取球体位置，激光根据实时坐标绘制轨迹；机械运动、计算控制与视觉残像共同形成空间结构。
themes: physical computation | kinetic system | tracking | light | particle behavior

materials_technology: laser | camera tracking | paper drawing | sound synthesis
mechanism: 摄像机读取激光轨迹，软件把空间位置、速度和形状映射为音高、节奏或控制信号，使绘画动作同时成为演奏动作。
themes: drawing as interface | laser tracking | notation | participation | sound visualization

materials_technology: electrical muscle stimulation | electromyography | facial electrodes | custom software
mechanism: 面部既作为输入端读取肌电或表情，也作为输出端接受电刺激；系统把音乐节拍、肌肉活动与表情变化组织成反馈回路。
themes: body-machine feedback | agency | facial interface | bio-signal | control

materials_technology: 96 kHz / 24-bit audio | 12-channel audio system | 10 speakers | 2 vibrators | anechoic room
mechanism: 十路扬声器与两路振子分别作用于耳朵和身体；低频、外耳道共振声音与座椅振动把同一信号拆成不同感官通道。
themes: haptics | auditory perception | low frequency | cross-modal perception | embodiment
